note: Medicine Bow NF campground just under 10,500 ft beside the Snowy Range Scenic Byway (WY-130), 32 miles from Saratoga or 18 from Centennial; opens late June or early July depending on snow. Silver Lake (17 acres, brook trout) lies through the trees to the southeast, with a trail around it; two trailheads at the campground. Water and trash in summer only. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov + catalog read: 17 sites (9 drive-in, 8 walk-in tent), trailers under 32 ft, 2 vault toilets, water, no hookups, $20, 8 people, 14 days. Booking: 7 drive-in sites reservable, rest + post-Labor Day FCFS (some_sites). Season manual left; rec.gov's FCFS season runs to Oct 31 (flag). Not waterfront holds (~180 m through trees). Phone empty -> (307) 326-5258. Pin fine.
